Session at World AI Summit 2026

Harsh Vardhan is a confirmed speaker at World AI Summit 2026, 14-15 October 2026, Sheraton Grand Bangalore Hotel at Brigade Gateway, Bengaluru, India. Session title, time and hall will be published on this page once the agenda is final. See the agenda.

About Harsh Vardhan

Harsh Vardhan is Global Head of AI and Digital Innovation at Apollo Tyres Ltd, a role he took up in June 2023. He leads the company's global digital innovation strategy, covering AI-led manufacturing, supply chain modernisation and Industry 4.0 programmes, and set up and scaled its Digital Innovation Hub in India. Work under him includes enterprise generative AI pilots with start-ups at T-Hub in Hyderabad, an in-house manufacturing reasoning tool and AI-based virtual compounding for R&D.

Before Apollo Tyres he was Chief Digital Transformation Officer for 'IDEA by Capgemini', the firm's data, AI and IIoT modernisation portfolio, from 2020 to 2023. From 2005 to 2019 he was at Cognizant, latterly as Associate Product Director and principal architect of its BigDecisions AI platform, after roles in big data analytics in London and as a data warehouse and BI architect in Singapore, the UK and the US.

He holds a postgraduate diploma in data science from IIIT Bangalore and completed an executive programme in digital transformation at the Indian School of Business.

About Apollo Tyres Ltd

Apollo Tyres Ltd, founded in 1972 and headquartered in Gurugram, is an international tyre manufacturer among the world's top 20 by size. It runs seven plants, five in India and one each in the Netherlands and Hungary, sells the Apollo and Vredestein brands in over 100 countries, and had FY2025 revenue of about Rs 26,100 crore and some 17,500 employees.
